title: scorzonera meshhedensis
intro: Scorzonera meshhedensis, commonly known as the Meshed scorzonera or Scorzonera meshhedensis, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to Iran. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving digestive health. The health benefits of Scorzonera meshhedensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and gastrointestinal protective effects. The bioactive constituents of Scorzonera meshhedensis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
